subject: an ivory ribbon-roof community hall
pose: near-frontal view across a broad plaza
art_direction: 象牙色带状屋顶折回包住公共厅，粉砂地面与青玻璃构成温柔原创建筑。
visible_description: 象牙色带状屋顶折回包住公共厅，浅石地面、静水倒影与柔和天光构成温柔原创建筑。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Create an ivory ribbon-roof community hall. The continuous roof folds down at one side to become a wall, leaving a tall central opening. Keep the highest fold below the upper fifth. A shallow pool and one low bench occupy the foreground, with no people or signs. Use soft daylight and broad clean surfaces to emphasize the continuous structure. Use minimal speculative architectural illustration. Vertical 1024x1536 wallpaper; reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet sky or light, with no text, logo, or watermark.
